# Lending Collateral Management Policy

This document outlines key directives for the management of lending collateral and associated risks.

*   Update collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Monitor default risk on a quarterly basis.
*   Update collateral value for strategy 2026 initiatives.
*   Optimize the standard update process for collateral values.
*   Investigate collateral value discrepancies for strategy 2026.
